Author: Sayuuryi
Name: Sawoo Boss Scaler
Description: Pick a size for every boss in every phase of the ultimate fights. Type /sbs to open it.
Punchline: Change the size of ultimate bosses, phase by phase.
Changelog:
### Bosses
- Pick a size from 10% to 200% for every boss in every phase of all seven ultimates
- Sizes change when the fight moves to the next phase and go back to normal after a wipe
- Set a boss to the same size in every phase, or every boss in a fight at once

### Settings
- Instant sizes, or a redraw through Penumbra if the instant option doesn't work for you

Author: Sayuuryi
Name: Sawoo Plates
Description: Adds a small menu bar to the Portrait Editor with preset codes, a preset library and finer camera controls.
Punchline: A few extra tools for the Portrait Editor.
Changelog:
### Presets
- Offers once to import presets you already have on this PC, with a button in Settings for later

### Fixes
- A failed start now cleans up after itself, so the next load or update isn't affected
